Design Standards

  • FIB (one–two words) is the primary type; MC always has five options (a–e) with obvious distractors
  • Correct MC letters are deliberately spread: S1 {d, c, e, a, c, e, b}, S2 {d, a, e, b, c, a, d}, S3 {c, e, d, b}, S4 {a, e, c}
  • No question uses a function before it has been introduced
  • Open-ended questions are limited; discussion prompts are reserved for teaching reflection
